Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.
What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

As a CE Driver, you'll manage regional trips starting from region Kortrijk.

Your days start early and you complete several trips a day. 

Looking for variety? Then this could be your next job. Apply quickly to find out if this is the right fit for you!

• Valid CE driver's license and Code 95

• Safety is your top priority

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights?? At least a high school diploma?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.
 
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What is Cream all about ?

 

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects

Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :

• Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements

• Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT

• Analyze the impact due to required evolutions

• Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations

• Design and document the to-be process

• Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing

• Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders

• Change management and deployment

• Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients

What do we expect from our consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset

• A knowledge of Business Process Modeling (ARIS, Visio, Camounda, UML, ...)

-

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.
